note: Tool manifest for mcp-maintainer. `mutates: true` tools write to DESIGN_FRAMES_DATA_DIR (or, once services are split, call the network API's authenticated write routes) — an MCP client should treat them as consequential. `mutates: false` tools are pure reads, safe to call speculatively.

tools.name: list_features
tools.description: List all design-frames features with their slug, name, frame count, and per-flow approval state.

tools.name: get_feature
tools.description: Get one feature's full manifest and every frame's HTML content.

tools.name: create_feature
tools.description: Create a new feature shell (manifest with no frames yet). Fails if the slug already exists.

sourceRepo.description: Which consuming product these frames are for, e.g. 'FuzeFront'.

tools.name: propose_frame
tools.description: Add or replace one frame: upserts its metadata into manifest.frames[] AND writes its HTML content. Use this to author a new screen or revise an existing one.

id.description: Stable frame id, matching the file stem, e.g. '01-invoice-history'.

tools.name: define_flow
tools.description: Add or replace a build.flows[] entry (the orchestrator/route a set of frames implements). Frames reference flows by id.

tools.name: compute_stamp
tools.description: Compute the current content stamp for a feature and compare it to the persisted one. Read-only — does not write.

tools.name: commit_stamp
tools.description: Compute AND persist the content stamp onto the manifest, binding future approvals to the current frame content.

tools.name: approve_flow
tools.description: Approve one flow within a feature.

tools.name: reject_flow
tools.description: Revoke a flow's approval, optionally with a reason.

tools.name: get_site_url
tools.description: Get the public review-site URL for a feature (or one of its frames), for sharing with reviewers.

file.description: Optional: link directly to one frame.
